repository_root: Local checkout; absolute local path omitted from release.
review_scope: Selected artifact, version, Knowledge, memory and task-acceptance contracts; no exhaustive code or live-state review.

sources.observed: DocumentVersion stores document/version IDs, snapshot key, content SHA256, workspace ID and JSON provenance.
sources.proposed_integration_or_limit: Potential immutable version/provenance anchor; a JSON field does not itself guarantee complete or faithful dependency lineage.

sources.observed: Document has stable entity-scoped identity, metadata, storage path, trash state and visibility/classification fields.
sources.proposed_integration_or_limit: Artifact dependency records must bind the actual version hash and respect access scope; origin metadata is not semantic dependence.

sources.observed: Snapshot helper copies through entity file handles and hashes stored bytes; create_version creates immutable-path snapshots under a mutation lock.
sources.proposed_integration_or_limit: Candidate capture boundary for source/output versions. The inspected ordinary constructor does not populate semantic provenance.

sources.observed: Structured metadata schema has origin, artifact, generation and external sections.
sources.proposed_integration_or_limit: An adapter could add versioned lineage schema without confusing contextual origin with causal evidence.

sources.observed: bind_document_to_workspace records produced/used workspace and task/agent/tool context; Knowledge membership is separate.
sources.proposed_integration_or_limit: Useful runtime origin, not complete source-to-output lineage. Audit gates must not grant membership or permissions.

sources.observed: ArtifactDocumentResolver binds or synchronizes generated local artifacts into canonical Document identities.
sources.proposed_integration_or_limit: Potential producer-side hook for sidecar dependency manifests; observed input reads still need separate instrumentation.

sources.observed: Delivery verifier checks exact identities, current read access, pinned byte hashes and revision stability before/after I/O.
sources.proposed_integration_or_limit: Potential version-bound gate input. A missing-dependency audit should supplement this boundary and preserve its file/ACL checks.

sources.observed: Task acceptance snapshot includes task/plan/steps, declared artifact manifest, verified hashes and bounded content. It distinguishes semantic acceptance from file identity.
sources.proposed_integration_or_limit: Potential application point for a frozen repair/audit decision bound to exact task, plan, source/output version hashes. Content truncation must not be mistaken for full semantic verification.

sources.observed: Step completion verifies reused artifacts or projects producer artifacts into Knowledge under the dispatcher path.
sources.proposed_integration_or_limit: Possible completion-time capture boundary; automatic source invalidation and cascade repair were not established by this inspection.

sources.observed: AgentMemory distinguishes workspace/agent scope; stores content, confidence, source, metadata, expiry and status.
sources.proposed_integration_or_limit: Possible linked-memory state; no dedicated complete influence graph is established by these fields.

sources.observed: Memory insertion adds content fingerprint, source/metadata, status and per-entity/agent/user scope.
sources.proposed_integration_or_limit: Fingerprint is dedup/content identity, not full semantic ancestry.

sources.observed: Runtime memory mounts carry scope, read/write flags and metadata; insight extraction asks for source message IDs.
sources.proposed_integration_or_limit: Source message IDs can support origin tracking but do not cover all downstream artifact dependencies.

sources.observed: Extraction validation checks emitted source message IDs belong to the input allowlist.
sources.proposed_integration_or_limit: Useful source admission check; this does not establish semantic entailment or cascade repair.

proposed_adapter_contract.semantic_limit: Statistical counts over validated labels do not establish label correctness or semantic repair correctness.

not_established: Preservation of valid human edits during automatic patching
Publication or delivery gate using finite-population dependency audits
public_package_boundary: This report includes paths, hashes and paraphrased findings only; it does not grant permission to copy or release private Manor implementation code.
